name: dbt for Orca
description: A data catalog for the dbt project in your workspace: explore models by folder, tag, schema or owner, read their docs, columns and tests, select with dbt selectors, see visual lineage, check a pull request's impact (changed models and everything downstream), and preview data through the project's own dbt (v1 dbt-core or v2 Fusion; Snowflake, ClickHouse, Postgres and any other adapter).

settings.title: dbt project folder
settings.description: Folder holding dbt_project.yml, relative to the workspace root. Leave empty to find it automatically.

settings.title: dbt command
settings.description: How to run dbt for data previews and parsing. Leave empty to use the project's .venv/bin/dbt, else dbt on PATH (dbt-core v1 or dbt Fusion v2).

settings.title: Base branch for Changes
settings.description: What Changes compares your branch with, usually the branch your pull request merges into. Leave empty for origin's default branch (else origin/main, origin/master, main or master).
